purpose: The Payment Gateway service accepts card payments from merchants, routes them to acquiring banks, and publishes status events for other teams.

components.name: Payments Edge Gateway
components.evidence: The request come from the merchant backend to Payments Edge Gateway.

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: The gateway do the first checks and forward the validated request to payments-core.

components.name: payments-db
components.evidence: It write the payment records to payments-db (PostgreSQL).

components.name: Acquirer connector
components.evidence: It send the authorization request to the acquirer through Acquirer connector.

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: It publish an event to payment-events (Kafka) which is consumed by ledger and notification teams.

flows.evidence: The gateway do the first checks and forward the validated request to payments-core.
It write the payment records to payments-db (PostgreSQL).
It send the authorization request to the acquirer through Acquirer connector.
It publish an event to payment-events (Kafka) which is consumed by ledger and notification teams.
